name: Shallum
bio: Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zachariah, king of Israel, struck him down in front of the people, killed him, and reigned in his place — fulfilling the LORD's old word to Jehu that his dynasty would last only four generations (2 Kings 15:10-12). Shallum himself reigned only a full month in Samaria before Menahem son of Gadi came up from Tirzah, struck him down, and killed him, taking the throne for himself (2 Kings 15:13-14).
